parameters.description: Comma-separated grouping dimensions, e.g. principal,model. Each must be one of principal, model, provider, with no repeats. Defaults to principal. user is deprecated in favour of principal and renders identically. The facet and label columns are always present in addition to these
parameters.name: group_by

parameters.description: Window start, RFC 3339 or YYYY-MM-DD (default 30 days back, including today)
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: Filter: restrict the label column to this facet's labels, exact match. The facet vocabulary is operator configuration, so an unknown value yields an empty result rather than an error. Sessions classified without a label for this facet are still counted, under (unset)
parameters.name: facet

parameters.description: Filter: served model of the underlying event, exact match
parameters.name: model
